description: Store JSON, text or a file for 1 to 365 days (default 7). Costs $0.01 USDC and includes 100 reads. Give exactly one of content (text/JSON), content_base64 (binary) or file_path (a local file). Returns id, a one-time secret, expiry and links. Keep the secret.

content_type.description: MIME type. Detected from the content when omitted.

file_path.description: Path of a local file to upload.

label.description: A label to recognise the item later.

name: store
